create_reasoning_parser: create a custom reasoning parser subclassing ReasoningParser to extract reasoning content from model output
build_reasoning_parser_manager: build a reasoning parser registry using ReasoningParserManager to register and retrieve parser implementations
test_extract_reasoning: test the ReasoningParser.extract_reasoning method to extract reasoning and content from a model-generated string
refactor_register_lazy: refactor the ReasoningParserManager.register_lazy_module to register a lazily loaded reasoning parser by module path and class name
review_import_parser: review the ReasoningParserManager.import_reasoning_parser method to dynamically load a user-defined parser from a file path
